settings.title: The atelier
settings.text: Tell the story of how the house began, who makes the work, and what it is made from. Two or three paragraphs are usually enough.

settings.quote: A garment is finished when nothing else can be taken away.

settings.title: What we hold to
settings.value_1_text: Every cloth is bought from a mill we can name.
settings.value_2_text: Edges, linings and buttonholes are worked by hand.
settings.value_3_text: Pieces are cut in short runs and rarely repeated.

settings.caption: Cutting, fitting and finishing, photographed over one season.
